hero.title: Jeffrey Fuhrer
hero.subtitle: Jeffrey (Jeff) Fuhrer, PhD Harvard University, is Executive Vice President and Senior Policy Advisor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Boston, and is responsible for the Bank’s regional and community outreach functions. He is an associate economist of the Federal Open Market Committee, and regularly attends this key U.S. policymaking meeting with the Bank’s president.
